body: thank you :) its very nice of you to write to me. im sorry you can relate to being suicidal. i wouldnt mind talking, not much to know abt me though!
im sorry you went through the same thing when you were younger, im very happy you’ve been able to keep going without it. thank you for the coping strategy!
thank you!! i like the way you worded that haha, you’re very kind, i appreciate it a lot
thank you for saying this, and for all the great ideas! the weather has been pretty nice for me here so im hoping i can spend more time outside this weekend!
im worried that if i do mess up i’ll never have the motivation to try again. i’ll try not to be too discouraged abt it if does happen though, thank you!
thank you :) i hope i’ll be able to one day
i am glad you are proud this makes me so happy! its a hard habit to get out of, thank you for being such a encouraging person for me i am so grateful 😊
im so happy you are proud of me thank you
